arxiv-2109-09787.title: Preparing Rernomalization Group Fixed Points on NISQ Hardware
arxiv-2109-09787.creator: Troy J. Sewell, Stephen P. Jordan
arxiv-2109-09787.description: Abstract Noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware [ 1 ] is typically limited to low-depth quantum circuits to limit the number of opportunities for introduction of error by unreliable quantum gates. A less-explored alternative approach is to repeatedly apply a quantum channel with a desired quantum state as a stable fixed point.

arxiv-2209-09638.description: Abstract Predicting the probability of non-performing loans for individuals has a vital and beneficial role for banks to decrease credit risk and make the right decisions before giving the loan. The trend to make these decisions are based on credit study and in accordance with generally accepted standards, loan payment history, and demographic data of the clients.

arxiv-2308-01766.title: Neural Poisson Surface Reconstruction: Resolution-Agnostic Shape Reconstruction from Point Clouds
arxiv-2308-01766.creator: Hector Andrade-LoarcaLudwig-Maximilians-Universität in Munich andrade@math.lmu.de, Julius HegeLudwig-Maximilians-Universität in Munich hege@math.lmu.de Daniel CremersTechnical University of Munich cremers@tum.de Gitta KutyniokLudwig-Maximilians-Universität in Munich kutyniok@math.lmu.de
arxiv-2308-01766.description: Abstract We introduce Neural Poisson Surface Reconstruction (nPSR), an architecture for shape reconstruction that addresses the challenge of recovering 3D shapes from points. Traditional deep neural networks face challenges with common 3D shape discretization techniques due to their computational complexity at higher resolutions.

arxiv-2409-11484.title: Off-shell color-kinematics duality from codifferentials
arxiv-2409-11484.creator: Maor Ben-Shahar
arxiv-2409-11484.description: Abstract We examine the color-kinematics duality within the BV formalism, highlighting its emergence as a feature of specific gauge-fixed actions. Our goal is to establish a general framework for studying the duality while investigating straightforward examples of off-shell color-kinematics duality.

arxiv-2505-09516.title: Depth-Based Local Center Clustering: A Framework for Handling Different Clustering Scenarios
arxiv-2505-09516.creator: Siyi Wang, Alexandre Leblanc, Paul D. McNicholas
arxiv-2505-09516.description: Abstract Cluster analysis, or clustering, plays a crucial role across numerous scientific and engineering domains. Despite the wealth of clustering methods proposed over the past decades, each method is typically designed for specific scenarios and presents certain limitations in practical applications. In this paper, we propose depth-based local center clustering (DLCC).

pmc-12509777.title: Analgesic Effectiveness of Magnesium Sulfate as an Adjuvant to Local Anesthesia in Symptomatic Irreversible Pulpitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-12509777.creator: Abdulwahab T Alenezi, Abdalla Alenezi, Salem Albadi, Abullah A Bakheet, Fawaz Alshammari, Abdulmuhsen F Alajmi, Mohammed Alkandari, Alya Almulla, Yousef Alqattan, Shahad Altaweel, Turki J Alshammari, Shouq Alshatti, Abdulaziz Almuthaybiri, Duaij Alsenafi
pmc-12509777.description: The inferior alveolar nerve block (IANB) is the most commonly used method for inducing pulpal anesthesia in patients with symptomatic irreversible pulpitis (SIP). Magnesium sulfate has been reported to increase the anesthetic effectiveness for endodontic procedures. Whether the adjuvant use of magnesium sulfate with IANB is effective in SIP patients remains uncertain.

pmc-12538904.title: Advanced stage melanoma during pregnancy: recommendations from a retrospective, multicentre, registry-based study
pmc-12538904.creator: Jessica SW Borgers, Douglas B Johnson, Elisabeth Livingstone, Dirk Schadendorf, Elizabeth I Buchbinder, Lauren E Haydu, Laura Gohil, William A Robinson, Inderjit Mehmi, Omid Hamid, Michelle Ferreira, April KS Salama, Florentia Dimitriou, Matteo S Carlino, Georgina V Long, Paolo A Ascierto, Ester Sim
pmc-12538904.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryBackgroundDiagnosis and treatment of advanced melanoma during pregnancy represents a major challenge, with scarce data on outcome or management available. Therefore, the Melanoma Pregnancy Taskforce collected real-world data to understand the current management approaches.MethodsThis retrospective, multicenter database included patients who were either diagnosed with advanced melanoma (newly diagnosed or recurrent) during pregnancy (group 1) or conceived while on systemic treatment (group 2) between 01/01/2011 and 07/31/2024.

pmc-12564691.title: CDK4/6 Inhibitors Suppress RB-Null Triple-Negative Breast Cancer by Inhibiting Mutant P53 Expression via RBM38 RNA-Binding Protein
pmc-12564691.creator: Jin Zhang, Kexin Wen, Ken-ichi Nakajima, Yang Shi, Xinbin Chen
pmc-12564691.description: Simple SummaryCyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 (CDK4/6) inhibitors, which are designed for targeting retinoblastoma (RB) protein phosphorylation and thereby block cancer cell growth, have been approved by the FDA as frontline targeted therapies for hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative breast cancer. This study explores the potential application of CDK4/6 inhibitors in RB-deficient tumors.

pmc-12845367.title: Genetic Diversity of Infectious Bronchitis Virus Genotype II in Poland
pmc-12845367.creator: Anna Pikuła, Anna Lisowska, Justyna Opolska, Katarzyna Domańska-Blicharz
pmc-12845367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The epidemiological situation in Poland for IBV GII (formerly known as D1466) has seemed stable over the years, but an increase in such infections has been recently reported. In this study, genetic characterization of the representatives of this genotype was performed in order to determine whether the new epidemic wave of GII IBV was responsible for changes in this status quo.

pmc-12976652.title: A Rare Case of Concurrent Urinothorax and Myelomatous Pleural Effusion
pmc-12976652.creator: Prachi Bhanvadia, Aarish Lalani, Sara Samadami, Amandeep Bawa, Laxman Wagle, Inger F Oey
pmc-12976652.description: IntroductionMyelomatous pleural effusion (MPE) is a rare complication of multiple myeloma, occurring in < 1% of cases and associated with poor prognosis. Urinothorax, another rare cause of pleural effusion, results from urine leakage into the pleural cavity, typically due to obstructive uropathy or trauma. Although both conditions are individually uncommon, their concurrent occurrence has not been previously reported.

pmc-12991985.title: Novel immunotherapeutic strategies for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: a comprehensive review
pmc-12991985.creator: Yixuan Li, Yingying Zhang, Can Zhu, Yimin Han, Xinyun Gao, Juanqing Yue, Ying Wang
pmc-12991985.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) represents the most prevalent histological subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, characterized by pronounced clinical and biological heterogeneity. Despite the incorporation of rituximab into the cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone (R-CHOP) regimen—achieving durable remission in approximately 60% of patients—30%–40% ultimately experience relapse or develop refractory disease, resulting in unfavorable clinical outcomes.

pmc-13090522.title: The influenza B virus candidate vaccine expressing H3 hemagglutinin developed in suspension MDCK cells confers protection against lethal H3N2 avian influenza in BALB/c mice
pmc-13090522.creator: Yushu Wu, Weiyang Sun, Yeting Xia, Yue Feng, Menglin Zhao, Tiecheng Wang, Xianzhu Xia, Fang Yan, Yuwei Gao
pmc-13090522.description: Highlights•Optimized a range of culture conditions for a chimeric recombinant influenza virus rA/B-H3 in MDCK suspension cells.•The optimized vaccine demonstrated complete resistance to the lethal attack of wild-type H3N2 influenza virus.•Demonstrated the reliability of the MDCK suspension cell platform for the production of the chimeric H3N2 candidate vaccine.

pmc-13201665.title: Squamous cell carcinoma in neglected lumbar myelomeningocele successfully managed by multidisciplinary surgical reconstruction
pmc-13201665.creator: Ben Ammar Nouha, Jaidane Olfa, Bouhani Malek, Khemir Aya, Ben Dhieb Tarek
pmc-13201665.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) arising within an untreated myelomeningocele (MMC) represents an exceptionally rare but devastating complication of this common neural tube defect, with only 15 cases documented in English literature prior to this report. We present the 16th documented case of SCC in a neglected lumbar MMC and provide a comprehensive critical appraisal of all 15 previously published cases to elucidate epidemiological patterns, treatment heterogeneity, and critical gaps in standardized management protocols.
